integrity: The theorem and examples are derived analytically; accompanying finite checks do not prove universal quantifiers. Earlier equivalent results may exist.
scientific_limitations: Exact-arithmetic, real SPD, one DEIM coordinate, one Krylov step; single-sampled scalar assumed nonzero. Unboundedness is limiting, not a pseudoinverse divergence at exact singularity. No oversampling, multi-step or floating-point inference.
title: The sharp dimension-dependent true-residual frontier for single-row DEIM–GMRES
